turkey.observable: PEAK active publishers / report population; not total affiliation
turkey.verification: Peak and population columns retained from upstream CSV. 2016-2021, 2023 and 2024 rows checked against primary report tables. 2014-2015 and 2022 retain upstream transcription unless subsequently annotated in the source-check log. The upstream average column duplicates peaks in 2017-2018; no average imputation is used. No claim that all underlying organizational records were independently audited.

newzealand.observable: No religion count / census usually resident population count (all residents, including unclassified/nonresponse)
newzealand.verification: 2001-2018 no-religion counts from Stats NZ 2019 release; 2023 from Stats NZ 2024 release. 2001 population from government Te Ara table; 2006 = 4,242,048 - 214,101 from Stats NZ; later totals from Stats NZ. Random rounding can produce differences of 3 persons across published tables. 2013 count uses the 2019 release value 1,635,345, not later 1,635,348.
newzealand.comparability: Uniform denominator does not remove nonresponse, processing or administrative-data changes. Complement is NOT exclusively religious. Published percentage series 29.6,34.6,41.9,48.2,51.6 is retained separately for a denominator/processing sensitivity analysis, not mixed into primary counts.
